Get KBL Teams

Source: R/kbl.R
kbl_teams.Rd

The current ten clubs with Korean and English names and the code of each club's D-League side.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kbl.or.kr/common/teamList

Usage

kbl_teams()

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: The current ten clubs with Korean and English names and the code of each club's D-League side. The columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py kbl_teams); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
team_codecharacterKBL team code (2-digit string, e.g. '50' = Changwon LG). Joins to /common/teamList teamCode, game tcodeH/tcodeA, t in text-cast. Not stable across ownership changes: the Anyang club is '40' (SBS) in 1997-98 and '70' today. D-League sides have their own codes (teamCodeD).
team_code_dcharacterTeam code of the club's D-League (reserve) side, in the same team-code space as teamCode.
team_namecharacterTeam short name (Korean, no space, e.g. Changwon LG); the English form is teamNameEn.
team_name_fullcharacterTeam full name (Korean).
team_name_encharacterTeam short name in English.
team_name_full_encharacterTeam full name in English (e.g. 'CHANGWON LG SAKERS').

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in kbl_seasons().

See also

Other KBL Functions: kbl_current_standings(), kbl_game(), kbl_game_leaders(), kbl_pbp(), kbl_period_scores(), kbl_player_box(), kbl_player_totals(), kbl_players(), kbl_playoff_games(), kbl_playoff_seeds(), kbl_playoff_series(), kbl_round_mvps(), kbl_rounds(), kbl_schedule(), kbl_score_track(), kbl_season_leaders(), kbl_seasons(), kbl_shots(), kbl_standings(), kbl_team_box(), kbl_team_tracks()
